name: Claude Managed Agents
summary: Anthropic's hosted agent harness (beta) that runs Claude as an agent in sessions on managed infrastructure, with each session in its own cloud or self-hosted sandbox.

skills.what: Agents attach Agent Skills (a directory with a SKILL.md), either Anthropic's pre-built skills or custom skills uploaded to the workspace, and a session also discovers skills in a mounted GitHub repository's .claude/skills folder; Managed Agents is in beta.

mcp.what: The MCP connector (beta) connects an agent to up to 20 remote MCP servers declared by URL in mcp_servers, with credentials supplied from vaults; the agent definition takes only remote servers (type url).

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled deployments (beta) run an agent on a recurring cron schedule and keep its run history.

sandboxes.what: Each session runs in its own isolated sandbox, either an Anthropic cloud sandbox (a fresh Linux container, beta) with limited or unrestricted networking, or a self-hosted sandbox on your own infrastructure.

sources.title: Cloud environment setup - Claude Managed Agents
